page_title: Image to Video AI Generator: Animate a Photo | AIVG

sources.entry: AIVG - Animate a photo into a short video with a choice of AI video models. #paid

summary.name: AIVG
summary.one_liner: AIVG is a web tool that animates a still photo into a short AI-generated video using a choice of AI video models, guided by a text motion prompt.
use_cases: animate a product photo into a listing video
add subtle motion to a still photograph
make a turntable-style orbit from a product image
animate fabric on a flat-lay garment photo
create a short clip from a starting image with a text prompt
summary.what_it_does: The page describes uploading a starting photograph (JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MiB, at least 300 x 300 px) and choosing an available AI video model to generate a short clip. Users describe one movement in a text prompt and can keep details recognizable. Examples shown are 5-second 1080p 16:9 clips, with generated audio off in the examples. Optional ending frames are supported by Seedance 2.0 and 2.5, and reference images (1-9) are supported with Seedance 2.0 Fast Reference. Generation shows a credit quote before submitting, and results can be reviewed, reused, or used as a source for video editing.
notable: Choice of AI video models including Kling 2.6 and Seedance 2.0/2.5
Starting frame, optional ending frame, and reference image inputs
Credit quote shown before each generation
Example prompts emphasize keeping product shape, color, and packaging unchanged
caveats: Uses a credit system; generations require credits, and buying credits does not start a generation
Ending frame and camera path are guidance only and may not match exactly
Ending frame supported only on Seedance 2.0 and 2.5; reference images only with Seedance 2.0 Fast Reference
